name: Suou Yukina
source:
Serina's twin sister. Ever since Serina left the village, she has been kept in the storehouse behind the Suou mansion, and is only allowed out at night.

Although she has a calm and kind personality, she sometimes shows an side of herself that is like a completely different person. She cares deeply for her sister and wants Serina to continue living happily in the outside world.

[Translated from [url=http://www.a-kaguya.com/products_HB/serina/index.html]Official Site[/url]]
